title: 第七章 百鸟粪前往黑风山第八章 凌虚子太清丹鉴
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
吴耀回到洞府，盘膝坐下，将那本残破的《五毒丹经》重新摊在膝上。
方才只是粗略翻了几页，便已觉得此书不凡，如今静下心来仔细研读，才发现自己还是低估了它。
夜明珠的柔光下，古旧的纸页泛着黄，边角多处残缺，有不少页码已经遗失。
但仅存的文字工整端严。
每一味药材的辨识、每一道丹火的火候、每一方丹药的君臣佐使配伍，都写得清清楚楚，条理分明。
开篇便是一句总纲。
“五毒者，天地之精也。
善用者为药，不善用者为毒。
药毒之间，存乎一心。”
吴耀逐页细读，越看越是心惊。
这本丹经对五毒的研究堪称登峰造极。
光是蜈蚣一味，便记载了三十六种不同的处理方法。
晒干为末可入散剂，酒浸七日可入汤剂，活体制毒可取毒腺，甲壳煅烧可入膏方。
蜘蛛毒液的采集与保存、蛇胆的炮制、蝎尾毒针的淬炼、蟾酥的提取与纯化。
每一种毒物都被剖析到了极致，从毒性药理到丹方应用，体系完备，逻辑严谨。
这不是一本邪书。
写这本丹经的人，一定是个对丹道有着极深理解的宗师级人物。
只不过他所走的路子与正统丹道不同，正统丹道用灵芝仙草，他用五毒之物。
但殊途同归，最终的目的都是炼出能够助人突破、增进修为的丹药。
吴耀这一研究便入了迷。

他将丹经中的每一页都反复研读，遇到残缺不全的地方便结合上下文推测补充，遇到晦涩难懂之处便在石壁上刻字推演。
日升月落，寒暑交替，他除了必要的修炼和饮食之外，几乎所有的时间都扑在了这本丹经上。
一年的工夫，他将丹经中记载的所有药材辨识和炮制之法吃透。
两年的工夫，他将凡俗级别的丹方全部掌握，从最简单的“五毒散”到稍复杂些的“蛇蝎祛风丸”。
每一种丹方的药理和炼制手法都烂熟于心。
到了第三年，他开始着手研究丹经中记载的最高级别丹方。
五毒归元丹。
这味丹药需要集齐五毒精。
以特定的君臣配伍入药，辅以数十味辅料，再用地火配合修士自身的真火炼制七七四十九日方能成丹。
成丹后，能帮助炼虚合道巅峰的修士冲破地仙瓶颈，踏入仙道。
五毒道人花了数百年时间收集五毒，就是为了炼制这味丹药。
可惜，丹经到这里便残缺了。
五毒归元丹之后，明显还有更高层次的丹方，但书页从这里断开，后面的内容早已遗失。
吴耀翻到残卷的最后一页，手指抚过参差不齐的断口，心中涌起一股遗憾。
content_en:
Wu Yao returned to the cave, sat down cross-legged, and spread the broken "Five Poison Pill Sutra" on his knees again.
Just after flipping through a few pages, I already felt that this book was extraordinary. Now that I calmed down and read it carefully, I realized that I still underestimated it.
Under the soft light of the night pearl, the old pages were yellowish, with many corners missing, and many page numbers had been lost.
But the only remaining text is neat and precise.
The identification of each medicinal material, the temperature of each elixir, and the compatibility of each elixir are all clearly written and organized.
It begins with a general outline.
"The five poisons are the essence of heaven and earth.
Those who use it well are medicine, those who use it poorly are poison.
Between medicine and poison, there is one mind. "
Wu Yao read carefully page by page, and the more he read, the more frightened he became.
The study of the five poisons in this Alchemy Book is the pinnacle.
For centipedes alone, thirty-six different treatment methods have been recorded.
The dried powder can be used as a powder, soaked in wine for seven days can be used as a decoction, the poison glands can be used to poison the living body, and the carapace can be calcined to be used as a paste.
The collection and preservation of spider venom, the processing of snake gallbladder, the tempering of scorpion tail poison needles, and the extraction and purification of toad venom.
Every poison has been analyzed to the extreme, from the pharmacology of toxicity to the application of elixirs, with a complete system and rigorous logic.
This is not an evil book.
The person who wrote this alchemy book must be a master-level figure with a profound understanding of alchemy.
It's just that the path he takes is different from the orthodox alchemy. The orthodox alchemy uses Ganoderma lucidum, while he uses the five poisons.
But different paths lead to the same goal, and the ultimate goal is to refine elixirs that can help people make breakthroughs and improve their cultivation.
Wu Yao became fascinated by this research.
He studied every page of the Alchemy Sutra over and over again, and when he encountered incomplete places, he would make inferences based on the context. When he encountered obscure places, he would carve inscriptions on the stone walls to deduce them.
The sun rises and the moon sets, and the cold and heat alternate. Apart from necessary training and diet, he spends almost all his time on this Alchemy Sutra.
In one year, he mastered all the methods of identifying and preparing medicinal materials recorded in the Alchemy Sutra.
In two years, he mastered all the common-level elixir prescriptions, from the simplest "Five Poison Powder" to the slightly more complicated "Snake and Scorpion Qufeng Pills".
The pharmacology and refining techniques of each elixir are thoroughly understood.
In the third year, he began to study the highest level of alchemy recorded in the Alchemy Book.
Five Poisons Gui Yuan Dan.
This elixir requires gathering all five poison essences.
It takes a specific combination of monarch and ministers to prepare the medicine, supplemented by dozens of auxiliary ingredients, and then uses earth fire and the monk's own true fire to refine it for seven, seven and forty-nine days before it can become a pill.
After completing the elixir, it can help monks at the peak of Lianxu Hedao break through the bottleneck of earthly immortals and step into the immortal way.
The Five Poison Taoists spent hundreds of years collecting the Five Poisons just to refine this elixir.
Unfortunately, the Alchemy Sutra is incomplete at this point.
After the Five Poisons Guiyuan Pill, there are obviously higher-level pill recipes, but the page is disconnected from here, and the subsequent content has long been lost.
Wu Yao turned to the last page of the fragment, ran his fingers over the jagged fractures, and felt a sense of regret in his heart.
